meta.title: beamlynx - Visual & Intuitive Database Queries
meta.description: Beamlynx is a visual database client. Click from one table to the next and the query writes itself. No SQL to write by hand.
meta.ogDescription: A visual database client. Click from table to table and let the query write itself.
meta.twitterDescription: A visual database client. Click from table to table and let the query write itself.

hero.description: Open a database and start clicking. Beamlynx draws your tables, and your query writes itself as you pick your way through them. The text sits right beside the diagram if you'd rather type.
hero.diagramAriaLabel: Diagram of the customers, orders, order_items and products tables joined in sequence, matching the query below

visual.title: Visual
visual.description: Not a wall of SQL. Your query is a picture of your tables and how they join.

interactive.title: Interactive
interactive.description: Every click runs the query. You watch the answer change as you go.

composable.title: Composable
composable.description: Click any part of the query, not just the last step you added. The rest stays as it is.

closing.heading: Connect a database and see what's in there.
